content_fields.title: Encrypt sensitive data at rest in the browser
content_fields.description: Keep the credential out of persistent client-side storage and bound its lifetime so there is nothing worth encrypting at rest in the browser.
content_fields.finding: The bearer token is handed to the client with no guidance or mechanism for protecting it at rest on the client side.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/apis/auth/services/get_token_service.py
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 15

response.set_cookie(
    "access_token",
    access_token,
    httponly=True,      # unreachable from JavaScript, never written to localStorage
    secure=True,
    samesite="strict",
    max_age=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60,
)
criteria: The token is never persisted in localStorage or sessionStorage.
Credentials held by the client expire in minutes, not a week.
Any sensitive value that must persist client side is encrypted with a key that is not also stored there.
